title: Kangaskhan EX 115/165 Full Art Ultra Rare Holo Korean 151 Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Kangaskhan EX card is a must-have for any serious Pokemon TCG collector. With its full art design and ultra rare holo finish, this card is sure to be a standout addition to any collection. The card features the abnormal creature type Kangaskhan, and is a basic stage Pokemon card. 

The card is manufactured by Nintendo and is in Korean language. It has a card number of 115/165 and is a Pokemon type card. This card is not autographed and has no speciality. It is a rare card and is perfect for those who enjoy collectible card games.
